name: Pullquote on photo — depth stage
description: A pullquote floating over a real photographic substrate on the dimensional depth stage (ADR-0028, dex p20 image-substrate). The atmospheric photo is the full-bleed backdrop plane (oversized to stay full-bleed across the camera move); the quote floats pin-sharp on the near plane over a soft central contrast-darken pool (depth-stage near plane can't carry a soft scrim, so legibility comes from darkening the opaque backdrop — 12:1+). A subtle camera push gives a gentle parallax breath. Aperture is 0 by design: a DOF focus-pull blooms bright near-plane text (the highlight-bloom catches the white quote), so the photo's softness comes from the baked image, not the DOF gather, keeping the quote crisp. The substrate is a bundled, deterministic in-repo image (atmosphere-warm) on the backdrop plane's textured branch. backgroundFill is the opaque-lane backstop.

content.title: Build on bedrock. The tide goes out; bedrock stays.
content.author: Scott Tolinski
